bench_press.name: Bench Press
bench_press.instructions: Lie on a flat bench, lower the bar to mid-chest, then press it back up until your arms are straight.
bench_press.tips: Keep your shoulder blades retracted and wrists stacked over your elbows.

incline_dumbbell_press.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
incline_dumbbell_press.instructions: On a 30–45° incline bench, press the dumbbells from shoulder level to overhead.
incline_dumbbell_press.tips: Don't let the elbows flare past 75° to protect the shoulders.

push_up.name: Push-Up
push_up.instructions: In a plank position, lower your chest to the floor and push back up.
push_up.tips: Keep a straight line from head to heels; don't let the hips sag.

cable_fly.name: Cable Fly
cable_fly.instructions: With a slight elbow bend, bring both cable handles together in front of your chest.
cable_fly.tips: Lead with the elbows and squeeze the chest at the end of the movement.

pull_up.name: Pull-Up
pull_up.instructions: Hang from a bar and pull your chin above it, then lower under control.
pull_up.tips: Drive the elbows down and back; avoid swinging.

bent_over_row.name: Bent-Over Row
bent_over_row.instructions: Hinge at the hips and row the bar to your lower ribs.
bent_over_row.tips: Keep a neutral spine and pull with your back, not your arms.

lat_pulldown.name: Lat Pulldown
lat_pulldown.instructions: Pull the bar down to your upper chest while keeping your torso upright.
lat_pulldown.tips: Think about pulling your elbows into your pockets.

seated_cable_row.name: Seated Cable Row
seated_cable_row.instructions: Pull the handle to your waist, squeezing the shoulder blades together.
seated_cable_row.tips: Keep the chest up and avoid rounding the lower back.

overhead_press.name: Overhead Press
overhead_press.instructions: Press the bar from shoulder height to overhead, then lower under control.
overhead_press.tips: Brace your core and don't lean back excessively.

lateral_raise.name: Lateral Raise
lateral_raise.instructions: Raise the dumbbells out to the sides up to shoulder height.
lateral_raise.tips: Lead with the elbows and use a controlled tempo — no swinging.

face_pull.name: Face Pull
face_pull.instructions: Pull the rope toward your face, splitting the handles by your ears.
face_pull.tips: Keep elbows high and focus on the rear delts.

barbell_curl.name: Barbell Curl
barbell_curl.instructions: Curl the bar up by flexing your elbows, then lower slowly.
barbell_curl.tips: Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.

hammer_curl.name: Hammer Curl
hammer_curl.instructions: Curl the dumbbells with a neutral (palms-in) grip.
hammer_curl.tips: Avoid swinging; control the lowering phase.

triceps_pushdown.name: Triceps Pushdown
triceps_pushdown.instructions: Push the cable down until your arms are fully extended.
triceps_pushdown.tips: Keep your elbows tucked and still throughout.

overhead_triceps_extension.name: Overhead Triceps Extension
overhead_triceps_extension.instructions: Lower the dumbbell behind your head, then extend the arms overhead.
overhead_triceps_extension.tips: Keep the upper arms vertical and close to your head.

dips.name: Dips
dips.instructions: Lower your body between parallel bars until your elbows reach ~90°, then press up.
dips.tips: Lean slightly forward for chest, stay upright for triceps.

wrist_curl.name: Wrist Curl
wrist_curl.instructions: Rest your forearms on your thighs and curl the weight up with your wrists.
wrist_curl.tips: Use a full range of motion and a light weight.

back_squat.name: Back Squat
back_squat.instructions: With the bar on your upper back, squat down until thighs are parallel, then stand.
back_squat.tips: Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.

leg_press.name: Leg Press
leg_press.instructions: Push the platform away until your legs are nearly straight, then return.
leg_press.tips: Don't lock the knees or let your lower back round off the pad.

romanian_deadlift.name: Romanian Deadlift
romanian_deadlift.instructions: Hinge at the hips lowering the bar along your legs, then stand tall.
romanian_deadlift.tips: Keep a slight knee bend and feel the stretch in your hamstrings.

leg_extension.name: Leg Extension
leg_extension.instructions: Extend your knees to lift the pad, then lower under control.
leg_extension.tips: Pause briefly at the top for a stronger contraction.

leg_curl.name: Leg Curl
leg_curl.instructions: Curl the pad toward your glutes by flexing your knees.
leg_curl.tips: Avoid lifting your hips off the bench.

hip_thrust.name: Hip Thrust
hip_thrust.instructions: With your upper back on a bench, drive your hips up until your torso is level.
hip_thrust.tips: Squeeze the glutes hard at the top and keep your chin tucked.

glute_bridge.name: Glute Bridge
glute_bridge.instructions: Lying on the floor, drive your hips up by squeezing your glutes.
glute_bridge.tips: Keep your ribs down and don't hyperextend the lower back.

standing_calf_raise.name: Standing Calf Raise
standing_calf_raise.instructions: Rise onto the balls of your feet, then lower your heels below the step.
standing_calf_raise.tips: Use a full range of motion and pause at the top.

plank.name: Plank
plank.instructions: Hold a straight body position on your forearms and toes.
plank.tips: Brace your abs and glutes; don't let the hips sag or pike.

hanging_leg_raise.name: Hanging Leg Raise
hanging_leg_raise.instructions: Hanging from a bar, raise your legs until your hips flex, then lower slowly.
hanging_leg_raise.tips: Avoid swinging — control the movement with your core.

cable_crunch.name: Cable Crunch
cable_crunch.instructions: Kneeling, crunch down by rounding your spine against the cable resistance.
cable_crunch.tips: Move at the spine, not the hips.

deadlift.name: Deadlift
deadlift.instructions: Lift the bar from the floor by extending your hips and knees, keeping it close to your body.
deadlift.tips: Keep a neutral spine and brace hard before each rep.

kettlebell_swing.name: Kettlebell Swing
kettlebell_swing.instructions: Hinge and swing the kettlebell to chest height using an explosive hip drive.
kettlebell_swing.tips: Power comes from the hips, not the arms or lower back.

burpee.name: Burpee
burpee.instructions: Drop to a plank, do a push-up, jump your feet in, and explode up.
burpee.tips: Keep a steady pace and land softly.

jump_rope.name: Jump Rope
jump_rope.instructions: Jump over the rope with small, quick hops on the balls of your feet.
jump_rope.tips: Keep your elbows close and turn the rope with your wrists.
